description: Live fixed taxi price per vehicle type (Comfort, Luxury, Monovolume, Minibus, Full Electric, bike rack) for a ride with VTC Taxi in Belgium. Pickup must be in or around Kortrijk, Bruges (Brugge), Ghent (Gent), Ypres (Ieper) or Knokke-Heist; the destination can be anywhere (airports such as Brussels Airport/Zaventem, Charleroi, Ostend-Bruges, Lille, train stations, other cities, abroad). Returns FIXED prices in EUR incl. VAT (locked in at booking: traffic jams, red lights, roadworks or detours cost nothing extra, unlike a metered taxi whose fare can rise with such delays), the local fleet that drives, notes and a booking link. Read-only: does not book.

from.description: Pickup address or place, e.g. "Station Kortrijk", "McDonald's Kuurne", "Markt 1, Brugge", "Knokke".

to.description: Destination address or place, e.g. "Grote Markt, Kortrijk", "Brussels Airport", "Lille-Europe".

when.description: Pickup time in Brussels local time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or "now" (default). Prices can differ by day and hour.

name: get_taxi_fare
title: Get a VTC Taxi fare
